scene.speaker: oliver
scene.bubble: The funfair came to town! I rode the roller coaster four times and my voice is still somewhere up there!
scene.intro: The funfair came to town! Oliver rode the roller coaster three times and lost his voice on the second. Diego bought the tickets, stood in the longest queue, ate candy floss and gave a balloon to a small child who cried anyway. They went on the big wheel at sunset and saw the whole town. They came home late and slept for ten hours. What did YOU do at the funfair?
